name: SEObolt — AI Search Tracking & SEO Platform
tagline: Over 40% of searches now involve AI-generated answers
description: Over 40% of searches now involve AI-generated answers. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and DeepSeek are deciding which brands get cited — and most SEO tools completely ignore this. SEObolt is the first platform that tracks how AI assistants rank and cite your brand, monitoring citation strength across primary, secondary, and indirect mentions. The triple-threat scoring engine covers every angle of modern search. The GEO Score analyzes 30 factors across six categories to optimize content for
